title: Meadow Glen Apartment Renovation Funds Approved
summary:
*   Accepted $50,000 in rental rehabilitation funds for community housing.
*   Approved a $100,000 budget increase for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation.
*   Allocated a total of $150,000 towards the rehabilitation of Meadow Glen Apartments on Cameron Road.
transcript:
•
MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
December 15, 1994
The meeting was called to order at 3:43 p.m. Present: Bruce Todd, Max Nofziger, Gus Garcia
Jackie Goodman, Eric Mitchell
Ronney Reynolds, Brigid Shea
Absent:
Agenda Item No. 80 (1) Approve Minutes of September 29, 1994 meeting. Motion The Board, on
Board Member Gus Garcia's motion and Board Member Jackie Goodman's second approved the
Resolution on a 6-0-0 vote with Board Member Ronney
Reynolds out of the room.
Agenda Item No. 81 (2) Accept $50,000 in Rental Rehabilitation Funds and amend the Austin
Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) 1994-1995 budget by increasing appropriations by
$100,000 to fund the rehabilitation of Meadow Glen Apartments located at 7418 Cameron
Road.
Motion
The Board, on Board Member Gus Garcia's motion and Board Member Jackie Goodman's second
approved the resolution on a 7-0-0 vote.
The meeting was adjourned at 4:00 p.m.
